name: Great-father Winter
summary: In Orgrimmar, Great-father Winter hears children's wishes during the Feast of Winter Veil. Smokywood Pastures hires him to bring cheer near Grommash Hold, though the long work wears on him.

sections.title: A Hired Myth
sections.body: In the Valley of Strength, an orc hired by Smokywood Pastures performs as Greatfather Winter. Ancient lore tells of a majestic elemental spirit who wanders the land, bringing snow and seasonal renewal. But this figure promotes company wares and entertains Horde children. Some say the commercial show cheapens genuine seasonal traditions. Still, few deny the festive excitement he brings to Orgrimmar's streets.

sections.title: Shift Work in the Valley of Strength
sections.body: Outside Grommash Hold, beneath decorated evergreens, Greatfather Winter hears children's wishes. They climb onto his lap and tell him what gifts they want. He promotes Smokywood Pastures discounts and offers holiday greetings, but the long shift wears him down. He says he keeps festive spirits in his pack to quiet the noise when work ends. Visiting adventurers bring him snacks to help him endure.

faq.q: Is this the real Greatfather Winter?
faq.answer: No. An ordinary orc hired by Smokywood Pastures dresses as the legendary Winter Veil figure and hands out holiday promotions in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Where can I find Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Find Great-father Winter in the Valley of Strength, just outside Grommash Hold, by the Feast of Winter Veil tree and holiday stalls.

faq.q: What does he do during the Feast of Winter Veil?
faq.answer: He entertains holiday-goers and listens to children's gift requests. He gives out Smokywood Pastures promotional tasks and hands out festive presents under the tree when the holiday peaks.

faq.q: Why does he want gingerbread cookies and milk?
faq.answer: The loud crowds and children taking turns on his lap leave him drained. He asks for gingerbread cookies and milk to keep his energy up through the shift.

faq.q: What does he think of his job?
faq.answer: The performance feels tedious and draining to him. He grumbles about eager children, rushes through company slogans, and counts the minutes until he can drink from a bottle of cheer in his bag.

faq.q: Does the Alliance have an equivalent figure?
faq.answer: Yes. The Alliance's Greatfather Winter is an elderly dwarf employed by Smokywood Pastures. Find him near the holiday tree in the Commons of Ironforge.

angles.text: For the Horde, he is the seasonal figurehead in Orgrimmar, offering festival gifts and tasks for Smokywood Pastures.
Chefs can bake gingerbread cookies with festive holiday recipes and bring them with milk to Great-father Winter to restore his spirits.
As an orc, seeing one of your own reduced to a costumed mascot selling vendor discounts can test a traditionalist's patience. Orcs revere seasonal shifts and the elements.
